a.lede: AI leaders have been promising that AI is the key to curing human disease. Anthropic researchers have also been warning that AI might kill us all.
a.title: Anthropic is operating a lab that conducts biology experiments

b.lede: State media outlet China Daily posits that Anthropic's Dario Amodei made the call to limit frontier AI development because Chinese AI models are catching up with American AI labs.
b.title: Chinese state media counters Anthropic's call to put brakes on AI development — paper says move is ‘a response to Chinese competition’
